informational: Nothing in this release changes the package's runtime. Its entire src/ diff is JSDoc, which feeds the generated token and component reference; every component behaves exactly as it did on 0.9.0.

THREE documented behaviours were guessable wrong, so check these if you use them - the code always worked this way, only the reference was silent. (1) ds-time-columns `value` is always HH:mm in 24h and `format` changes only the DISPLAY, so a picker showing 12h still emits 24h - code that parsed the emitted value as 12h was wrong. (2) ds-time-columns `minTime`/`maxTime` DISABLE the out-of-range rows rather than removing them, so the columns keep their height as a bound moves - a layout that assumed the list shortens was wrong. (3) ds-calendar-day `tabIndex` is a roving tabindex owned by the grid (exactly one cell at 0, the rest at -1), not a tab position to set per day - setting it per cell fights the grid's keyboard model.

41 public tokens and props gained descriptions in the reference: 10 --ds-* tokens (the whole --ds-password-rules-* set, --ds-multi-select-panel-bg-color and --ds-menu-item-radius among them) and 31 inputs and outputs across ds-calendar-day, ds-time-columns, ds-field-message, ds-divider, ds-sidenav-footer and the three layout primitives. Names, types and defaults are unchanged.

Every version's migration manifest now carries its DELETE-LIST entries, so an upgrade tool can act on what a release made UNNECESSARY and not only on what it broke. 0.9.0 has 21 of them. They are machine-readable now rather than prose.
